ask: Save a Threads post: "Our winter blend is back Friday. Tell us your favourite way to brew it." Only accounts we follow should be able to reply; last time we got spam.

arguments.content: Our winter blend is back Friday. Tell us your favourite way to brew it.

steps.why: The decision: "only accounts we follow" is Threads' own accounts_you_follow, not followers (that means the brand's followers). Bolta keeps it as the Threads setting, so platform_details on the saving call takes it, and refuses a misspelling (the result's platform_details.threads says so) while the draft is still saved.
Read back reply_control from the Threads settings before saying replies are limited.

say: Saved to Acme as a Threads draft: "Our winter blend is back Friday. Tell us your favourite way to brew it." Only accounts you follow can reply. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule it?
never: followers for "accounts we follow": that limits replies to the brand's followers.
accounts_you_follow on X: X's word for accounts the brand follows is followers.
Saying replies are limited before reading it back.
